features.statement: Page has no h1; top-level headings are h2s, and heading levels are skipped (h2 followed directly by h4 in widgets).
Content is wrapped in semantic landmarks (header, nav, main, aside, footer) with many section and article elements.
Page is link-dense, with a very high anchor count relative to the amount of text.
Dates are marked up with time elements, matching the many post dates on cards and sidebar lists.
Content thumbnails use empty alt text; only the logo and the author photo have descriptive alt text.
Serif font is used for wordmark, tagline, excerpts and subtitles, while titles and metadata use sans-serif.
Section headings and labels are uppercase, letter-spaced, bold small caps-style text.
Meta text such as bylines is very small, gray sans with a middle-dot separator.
Body text uses a comfortable line height of about 1.55.
A single saturated brick-red accent is used for badges, buttons, links and numerals against navy and white.
Dark navy is used for the top bar, bands and footer.
Section headings sit on a dark rule with an accent-colored 'View all →' link on the right.
Category badges are small square-cornered rectangles with white uppercase letter-spaced text on an accent fill.
Cards follow a consistent anatomy: thumbnail, category badge, bold title, byline with date, and optional serif excerpt.
Posts without images show a navy gradient placeholder tile with the category name in spaced caps.
Sidebar has an author card with a circular photo, bold name and serif subtitle.
Sidebar lists use small thumbnail, title and date rows with thin dividers; the popular list has large accent numerals.
Category lists are plain text rows with thin dividers, with a tag cloud of outlined pill chips.
Search form pairs a text input with a square-cornered accent button.
A trending strip shows an accent label followed by a row of post titles truncated at the edge.
Hero is a two-column grid with one large cropped feature image beside two stacked smaller cards.
Main content uses a three-column card grid beside a narrow right sidebar within a centered container.
Footer is a multi-column dark band with uppercase white headings.
Layout combines flexbox and grid containers.
Cards in a row have uneven heights, leaving blank white space beneath shorter cards.
Design is flat: square corners, no shadows, blur, animations or transforms.
Thumbnails mix cartoon illustrations, clip-art, flat icons and stock photos with inconsistent style.
The same posts repeat across hero, section grids and sidebar lists.
Headlines contain awkward synonym-substituted wording that reads as machine-paraphrased.
Copy has no emoji, em dashes or exclamation marks; tone is plain and informational.
Wordmark text is truncated or misspelled relative to the document title.
Section groupings reuse a generic category badge label across all cards in a section.
